'''Ark Brell''' was a environmentalist who worked to clean up his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Brell set up a number of [[Water/Legends|water]] purification and waste disposal plants on Taris, intending to turn the waste from Taris's numerous [[Factory/Legends|factories]] into alternative [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] sources and to minimize the [[City/Legends|city]]-world's waste. However, when the planet was [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malak]], many of the world's factories and plants were destroyed and spilled toxic waste across the surface. Hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the area around the [[Taris ChemWorks Factory]] had become known as the [[Brell Sediment]], and an [[Acid/Legends|acid]] lake in the area had been named [[Lake Brell]] after the environmentalist, as a persistent legend stated that the lake had been formed by the waste from one of Brell's own factories.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ark Brell was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Brell Sediment in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
